name: ANSI/IEEE Converter substation form
aliases: IEEE Converting Substation, In Service Or Unspecified
summary: IEEE-library reference for converter substation, with its operating meaning, connection notes and public vendor block identity.
description: This reference locates converter substation in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented power stations family. A converter-substation representation identifies a documented facility where an electrical conversion function forms part of the network connection. Its actual conversion equipment and AC/DC boundaries require linked design drawings. The public library uses HDV1_S00406 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.

Identify which network quantities or interfaces the station converts. A converter station is a system-level facility, not a single generic converter component. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
